policies.title: United Arab Emirates ordinary passports: provisionally applied EU short-stay waiver
policies.summary: UAE ordinary-passport holders are visa-free under the provisionally applied EU agreement; final entry into force was not established in this review.
conditions: The agreement was provisionally applied from signature on 2015-05-06; no Official Journal final entry-into-force notice was located in this review.
Applies to valid ordinary passports; the agreement also names diplomatic, service, official and special passports, which this policy does not model.
Paid activity is excluded; ordinary entry and short-stay conditions and refusal powers remain applicable.
Maximum stay is 90 days in any 180-day period; treaty-era non-fully-Schengen Member-State stays are separately calculated.
Ireland is excluded. France and the Netherlands are covered only in their European territories.
The EU agreement does not itself establish this rule for Norway, Iceland, Switzerland or Liechtenstein; its joint declaration calls for comparable bilateral agreements.
